test_raw_ptr_capsule: test extracting an int from a raw pointer capsule using get_int_from_raw_ptr_capsule
test_shared_ptr_capsule: test extracting an int from a shared pointer capsule using get_int_from_shared_ptr_capsule
test_bad_capsule_error: test that a bad capsule returns an INVALID_ARGUMENT error with the expected name
test_not_a_capsule_error: test that passing a non-capsule object returns an INVALID_ARGUMENT error
test_raising_get_capsule: test that a get_capsule method raising RuntimeError returns an INVALID_ARGUMENT error
